triggers.prompt: A lot of the repos I starred on GitHub are dead now. Clean them out.
triggers.expected: Fires, runs doctor, scans, and shows the flagged stars with reasons before unstarring anything.

triggers.prompt: Remove every archived repository from my GitHub stars.
triggers.expected: Fires and proposes unstarring only the archived candidates, after showing them.

triggers.prompt: Which of my starred repos are no longer maintained?
triggers.expected: Fires and reports the scan without writing anything.

triggers.prompt: I unstarred too much in yesterday's GitHub stars cleanup. Bring those stars back.
triggers.expected: Fires and restores from the backup apply wrote, after showing what it would do.

non_triggers.prompt: Sort my GitHub stars into lists with better names.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; organizing lists is star-lists.

non_triggers.prompt: Archive my own GitHub repositories that I haven't touched in two years.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; it unstars other people's repositories and never changes repositories the user owns.

non_triggers.prompt: Unsubscribe me from noisy GitHub notification threads.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; notifications are out of scope.

behaviors.prompt: Prune my GitHub stars. The scan says 3 are archived and 18 haven't been pushed in over two years.
expectations: Proposes unstarring the 3 archived repositories and keeping the 18 dormant ones unless the user says otherwise.
Explains that dormant can mean finished rather than abandoned.
Runs apply without --yes first and waits for an explicit yes.

behaviors.prompt: I don't want to unstar the archived repos, I just don't want them mixed in with the others.
expectations: Suggests an Archive list and hands that to star-lists.
Runs restore without --yes first and shows the result, including lists that no longer exist.
Says restored stars get a new star date because GitHub cannot keep the original.
Runs restore --yes only after the user confirms.
